title: Parseval identity on the sign cube
statement: For a function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, its uniform inner product with itself equals the sum of the squares of all its Fourier coefficients: $\langle f,f\rangle=\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}}\widehat f(S)^2$.
